appearance: A sixteen-year-old girl with a wholesome, approachable beauty and a quiet strength in her bearing. Her shoulder-length brown hair is tied back with a simple pale ribbon, a few loose strands framing her face and falling softly against her cheeks. Her face is gently rounded with warm, inviting green eyes—soft tareme shape, open and alert—and neatly arched brows. A small pale scar marks the skin just above her left eyebrow, a visible reminder of a childhood mishap. Her skin is light with a healthy glow, smooth and sun-touched from time spent outdoors. Her build is slim and slight, the frame of a young woman whose work keeps her active but not heavily built; small breasts consistent with her youthful, slender figure. Her hands, though not visible in detail, rest naturally at her sides, and her posture is upright and quietly confident. She stands evenly balanced, weight centered, one hand lightly at her hip, the other relaxed. Her gaze meets the viewer's eyes with a gentle, welcoming smile, open and sincere. She wears a simple cream linen blouse and a practical woolen skirt in muted earth tones. Full body, head to toe, against a plain grey background.
